summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Super Admin V2 features including Group Verification, Group Disable/Enable, User Impersonation, Activity Logs, and CSV Export. All 15 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI flows verified working.
passed_tests: Super Admin Login: Returns is_super_admin=true in user object
Regular Admin Login: Returns is_super_admin=false in user object
Super Admin Stats: Includes pending_verification and disabled_groups counts
Groups List: Includes is_verified, is_disabled, trial_hours_remaining, trial_expired fields
Group Verification: PUT /api/superadmin/groups/{id}/verify toggles verification status
Group Disable: PUT /api/superadmin/groups/{id}/disable toggles disabled status
Activity Logs: GET /api/superadmin/activity-logs returns logs with admin_name, action, details, created_at
Activity Logs: Admin actions (verify, disable, impersonate) are logged with timestamps
User Impersonation: POST /api/superadmin/impersonate/{user_id} creates session and returns is_impersonated=true
User Impersonation: Non-existent user returns 404
CSV Export: GET /api/payroll/earnings/csv returns text/csv with semicolon delimiter
CSV Export: Requires authentication (401 without session)
Group Access Blocking: Disabled groups have sessions terminated
Trial Period: Groups have trial status fields calculated correctly
New Group Registration: Creates group with trial_started_at
Frontend: Super Admin page loads with Groups/Users/Activity tabs
Frontend: Stats cards show Pending and Disabled counts
Frontend: Groups tab shows Verify/Disable buttons with correct state
Frontend: Users tab shows View As (impersonate) and Ban buttons
Frontend: Activity tab shows admin activity logs with timestamps
Frontend: Group verification toggle works (button text changes)
Frontend: Group disable toggle works (button text changes)
Frontend: User impersonation redirects to dashboard as target user
Frontend: Payroll Earnings tab shows month/year selector
Frontend: Export CSV button conditionally shown when data exists
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. All test actions (verify/disable) properly restored to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin V2 features fully working: 1) Group Verification via PUT /api/superadmin/groups/{id}/verify toggles is_verified field, 2) Group Disable via PUT /api/superadmin/groups/{id}/disable toggles is_disabled field and terminates user sessions, 3) User Impersonation via POST /api/superadmin/impersonate/{user_id} creates 2-hour session with is_impersonated=true, 4) Activity Logs at GET /api/superadmin/activity-logs tracks all admin actions with timestamps, 5) CSV Export at GET /api/payroll/earnings/csv returns semicolon-delimited CSV. Frontend SuperAdminPage has Groups/Users/Activity tabs with proper data-testid attributes. Stats cards include pending_verification and disabled_groups counts. Trial period enforcement in require_auth middleware blocks access after 24 hours for unverified groups.
